description: This file contains utility functions, type definitions, and rendering components related to channel display and status management in a UI, specifically for handling channel states, accounts, and rendering channel cards.

methods.name: resolveChannelStatus
methods.description: Resolves the status object for a specific channel key from the provided props.

methods.name: resolveDefaultChannelAccount
methods.description: Finds and returns the default account snapshot for a given channel key from the props.

methods.name: resolveChannelDisplayState
methods.description: Computes and returns the display state of a channel, including configuration, connection, and account status.

methods.name: channelEnabled
methods.description: Determines if a channel is enabled based on its display state.

methods.name: resolveChannelConfigured
methods.description: Returns the configured status of a channel.

methods.name: formatNullableBoolean
methods.description: Formats a boolean or null value into a human-readable string ('Yes', 'No', or 'n/a').

methods.name: renderSingleAccountChannelCard
methods.description: Renders an HTML card component for a single account channel with status and error information.

methods.name: getChannelAccountCount
methods.description: Returns the number of accounts associated with a specific channel key.

methods.name: renderChannelAccountCount
methods.description: Renders an HTML element showing the count of accounts if there are two or more.
